title: intent-becomes-a-learning-block
intention: /intent BECOMES THE FIRST SKILL THAT FIRES INSIDE THE LEARNING BLOCK ANATOMY, and the migration is the template the other eight copy. It gains: a declared input contract at its door; a consumer-typed trace of EVERY firing, greens included; a stratum-tagged bullet-list finding at BOTH its exits; and Akien's verdict on that finding recorded as a training pair. The door is PHYSICS, not policy — a ticket carries the berth its /intent firing produced, and the gate that already refuses a BUILDME without a claiming chart packet refuses one without an /intent berth too.
why: Child b of skills-migrate-one-blow, whose why is Akien's: 'we're not dogfooding our most important element in the thing we do EVERY SINGLE DAY' — the builds learn, the building doesn't. /intent goes first because it is link 1 of the work loop and because its OWN CHARTER ALREADY AUTHORED THIS: how_it_learns reads 'By downstream rejection... that miss becomes a gate-record and /intent's question set gains a question. Endpoint into cc-learning-store; interim by-hand.' This ticket is that interim ending. Not a new intention — a written-down one reaching its endpoint (Law 1: carrying the settled answer rather than re-deriving it).
traces_to: Law 2 — CP1-CP6 hold in the process that builds the system; this puts the work loop's first link under its own gates
Law 4 — /intent's discipline is prose in SKILL.md today, and prose is an IOU against physics
Law 3 — 'nothing for you to skate with' stays a HYPOTHESIS until refusal and escape rates have a denominator; this builds the instrument for link 1
Law 1 — a routing miss caught downstream is a settled answer being re-derived at cost
I-the-system-is-a-learning-block (the spanning intention this campaign serves)
skill:/intent's own charter how_it_learns — the endpoint it named and could not reach by hand

proves_green.prove_gate: derivation gate — `cairn cairnmap --gate` green: /intent renders from its intention+why.json and no charter-less command renders. The skill class's distinguishing extra gate; the charter changes in this build, so this gate is live, not ceremonial.
proves_green.proof_gate: proof teeth through the tester where this touches code — the berth writer, whatever shell reach the skill needs, and the entry-gate check. Sealed netns, validation beside the code.
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until proven AND durably committed (git).

falsifier.proves_red: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) /intent fires and leaves no trace — GREENS INCLUDED; the unrecorded green destroys the denominator; (2) /intent reaches either exit without emitting a bullet-list finding, or emits bullets no gate ever sees; (3) the anatomy is prose in SKILL.md rather than a call into the primitive — discipline wearing physics' clothes, inherited from the parent's falsifier (5); (4) the door never REDS across the first measurement window while inputs are demonstrably imperfect — a gate that cannot refuse is vacuous (the coin-toss-green lesson), and this is the watch's own question; (5) THE TEMPLATE CLAIM FAILS — migrating skill #2 cannot copy the pattern without redesign, meaning child b produced a one-off and not the template brick it is chartered as; (6) a ticket reaches BUILDME carrying no /intent berth and the gate lets it through — the ruling of 2026-08-01 unimplemented while the ticket claims done.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read when skill #2 (/challenge, child c) migrates — that is when the template claim (falsifier 5) is first measurable rather than asserted. The watch's own horizon is the first window in which /intent fires on real work.
